name: Email
note: The agent has its own inbox
summary: Giving an agent its own email address lets anyone reach it without a new app, and lets it handle sign-ups, verification codes and threads. Options range from inbox APIs built for agents, such as AgentMail, to receiving mail in code with Cloudflare Email Workers, to connecting a person's existing mailbox through the Gmail API.
facts: Standard email (SMTP/IMAP) plus provider APIs and webhooks
Inbox API with webhooks, WebSockets, IMAP/SMTP, MCP server
email() handler can forward, reject or reply
None; needs a domain with SPF, DKIM, DMARC for good deliverability
goodFor: Asynchronous agents that work in threads
Agents that sign up for services or receive codes
Reaching people who live in their inbox
watchOut: Personal mailboxes may be suspended for automated use
